title: Can't Reach the DB
story: The api was redeployed onto the web network only, and every request now times out waiting for the database. Policy says the web frontend must never talk to the database directly.
objective: Give api a network path to db, keep web and api connected, keep web away from db, and leave exactly three mission containers.
hints: Containers can talk only when they share a network. docker inspect shows each container's networks.
docker network connect NETWORK ALIAS attaches an existing container to another network without restarting or replacing it.
Try docker network connect db-net api. Connecting db to web-net instead would expose the database to web.
explanation: A container can belong to several networks at once. Connecting api to the database network gives it a second path while it stays on the web network, and web gains no route to the database.
